name: Cut
description: Lose HP equal to stacks at the start of your turn (ignores block). Loses 1 stack each turn.

name: Wide Open
description: Each hit against you deals +1 damage per stack. Loses 1 stack each turn.

name: Swagger
description: Your next attack card deals +1 damage per stack to its first hit. Then it is spent.

name: Winded
description: Start your next turn with 1 less energy per stack.

name: Seeing Stars
description: Draw 1 fewer card per stack next turn.

name: Tight Guard
description: Gain +1 extra block per stack whenever you gain block. Loses 1 stack each turn.

name: Counterpunch
description: When an enemy hits you, they take damage equal to stacks. Clears at the start of your turn.
